summary: Resolved DS4-R1 and DS4-R2 by adding Forms to the generated dependency plan and compiling/running a real Angular TestBed CVA suite.

resolutions.description: The Angular CLI dependency plan now installs @angular/forms at ^22.0.0, or preserves a consumer-declared dependency/devDependency range; a CLI fixture verifies the latter.

Added Angular compiler-backed TestBed tests for Reactive Forms, formControlName, template-driven forms, values, reset, touched, invalid inputs, disabled composition, callbacks/output non-emission on writes, radio names/options, and switch interaction.

validation.command: corepack yarn install && corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular test && corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular check && corepack yarn build && corepack yarn check && git diff --check
